authority: Step 7 of notebooks/Schema_Design_and_Mapping.ipynb; this contract supersedes earlier draft conventions only where explicitly stated.

formats.processed: UTF-8 JSONL; one JSON object per row; arrays/objects preserved; explicit nulls; no NaN/Infinity; fixed field contract; stable ID sort for output
formats.numbers: Original values/types and raw evidence retained; derived decimal quantities serialized as decimal strings, never binary-float comparison values
formats.paths: Project-relative artifact paths and exact typed locators
formats.missingness: Explicit null plus source-field presence/missingness state; absent source fields must not be confused with null
formats.graph_export: Deferred; no Neo4j import or graph CSV in this pilot

build.repeat_policy: Same build key must verify identical output bytes or raise reproducibility conflict; never overwrite a changed prior build.

identity_keys.encoding: Typed JSON arrays of namespace/type/string identity components, UTF-8 with ensure_ascii=True and separators=(comma,colon); SHA-256 digest prefixed by entity kind. Components must not use floats or ambiguous concatenation. Implementation fixtures required.
identity_keys.pilot_snapshot_scope: Conservative container-bound source representation; a containing-file change can version every member. The digest describes the entire retained container, not the isolated record. Preserve locator and payload_scope. No false claim of per-record semantic fingerprinting.
derived_assertion: source locator or native annotation ID
identity_keys.canonical_identity: Opaque persisted IDs only after acceptance; canonical identity table remains empty in pilot.
identity_keys.profile_migration: json-lossless-tree-v1 is deferred until its fixtures pass; later adoption creates a new profile and explicit migration, not rewritten snapshot IDs.

dsld.identity: id -> source_records.native_id; brandName/fullName/offMarket/entryDate and product review fields -> snapshots.attributes
dsld.occurrences: ingredientRows recursively; nestedRows; forms; otheringredients.ingredients and forms. Preserve parent locator/role, ingredientId/name/notes/description/prefix/percent.
dsld.assertions: Every quantity entry -> one composition assertion; unusable quantities retained with original unit/operator/basis and blocked normalized amount. Rows without quantity -> presence assertion. Forms never inherit parent amount.
dsld.servings: servingSizes[] -> servings; quantity basis stored independently; resolve servingSizeOrder within label snapshot only.
dsld.statements: Directions, precautions, storage -> label_statement assertions, original type/text; general marketing deferred.
dsld.references: labelRelationships[] -> source_references, no automatic product grouping.
dsld.deferred: Images/contacts/marketing and daily-value percentages remain raw; original quantity evidence retains full source object.

pubchem.identity: records[{cid}].cid and properties.CID must agree -> source_records/ChemicalCompound role.
pubchem.attributes: properties Title/IUPACName/MolecularFormula/MolecularWeight/ConnectivitySMILES/InChI/InChIKey and synonyms -> source snapshots/term_values with typed evidence.
pubchem.lookups: queries occurrences -> lookup_origins; search_results and request/method/status -> lookups; every returned target -> separate mapping candidate for each exact source occurrence.

rxnorm.attributes: name/tty/language/suppress; NAMES, selected UNII_CODE/DRUGBANK/SNOMEDCT CODES and SOURCES properties -> term_values/snapshot attributes.
rxnorm.lookups: Preserve exact/normalized sequence and all targets; flags/validity never approve mappings.
rxnorm.deferred: SPL_SET_ID bulk remains raw; blank umlscui is not a key.

mesh.identity: Full subject URI and RDF role -> source_records when described; object-only targets -> source_references.
mesh.attributes: Retain typed RDF values, datatype/language, labels and scope notes on actual subjects.
mesh.relationships: Original concept/term/hierarchy/mapping predicates -> vocabulary_statements with snapshot provenance; no sameAs conversion.
mesh.lookups: queries/search_results/resolution responses/candidate_record_index preserve term/concept/record distinction and complete candidates.

natmedpro.identity: Monograph id and native claim id retained; source/import/annotation representations distinguished.
natmedpro.assertions: claim type/text, ingredient/formulation/strain, population/indication, all ratings, dose and interaction objects -> clinical assertion attributes. Nulls preserved; all existing clinical reviews stay pending.
natmedpro.support: source.record_id/section_index/start/end/excerpt -> evidence. Each field_support span keeps its coordinate system/role; no assumption all anchors lie inside main excerpt.
natmedpro.references: Local citations only when explicitly located and scoped; no bibliography-wide claim-to-study links. Reference documents retained with capture provenance; claim citation extraction deferred.
natmedpro.passages: Preserve upstream passage ID/section/word window/chunk version as passage provenance; not independent clinical evidence.

reddit.identity: native_id/record_type validated against t1/t3; id wrapper preserved.
reddit.topics: supplements/matched_terms + record-level mention_scope -> topic_associations; own_text does not prove every topic individually mentioned.
reddit.references: parent_id and thread_id -> separate source_references; unknown parent not inferred from thread.
reddit.passages: Word-window provenance remains distinct from character support spans.
reddit.forbidden: No Reddit ClinicalAssertion extraction or clinical approval in POC.

pilot.terminology_scope: Saved candidates, definitions and lookup provenance connected to selected label occurrences; plus saved MeSH D017962/D015525 hierarchy fixture. Declare exactly selected source objects in input manifest; no network expansion.
allowed_normalization_rules: N-I01 source field-specific integer/string ID representation
pilot.preconditions: Validate rule fixtures and source hashes before generating pilot outputs. No alias decision auto-acceptance, no conflicting-dose arithmetic.
pilot.deduplication: D-01 exact archived-input replay suppression only; do not merge distinct source IDs, captures, occurrences or assertions.
pilot.date_handling: Copy source dates/roles verbatim in pilot; typed date conversion deferred unless explicitly added and tested.

validation_gates.checks: All selected artifacts match pinned hashes; declared selection paths exist; source IDs/types/locators agree.
Required columns/types/enums, unique IDs, valid FKs, nonempty evidence for source-backed assertions; unresolved target keys never emitted as fabricated record FKs.
Reconcile selected row/form/quantity/topic/reference counts to source; preserve null vs absent, hierarchy, source roles, fields selected for projection and all raw values.

validation_gates.failure_action: stop build on wrong transformation; queue supported source gaps
validation_gates.checks: 1.5g->1500mg exact decimal; same numerical value with different basis not equivalent; zero NP vs zero mg; inequalities, ranges and conflicts; no parent amount propagation.
Validate claim/source spans and field-support coordinates independently; preserve clinical pending, identity states, reference resolution and Reddit mention scope; no approvals produced.
Null parent vs uncollected target distinct; captured incomplete target can resolve; replay same input creates no duplicate logical rows; new capture/update fixtures retain history.
Deterministic output hashes on rerun; raw/read.md and prior artifact hashes unchanged; no output key reused with differing bytes.
Display positive, negative and ambiguous outputs with provenance; report unresolved counts by entity/row unit; inspect results before widening scope.

open_items: Scope/alias evidence and fully specified mixture identity not universally resolved (G1).
No final product grouping across 400 labels (G2).
Reference storage and task-completeness profiles need implementation validation (G3).
Lossless fingerprint profile and lifecycle implementation need tests (G4).
Contract is not a complete JSON Schema validator; implement structural and semantic validation gates before transformations.
table_constraints: All fields declared in a table are required in each emitted row; nullable values remain explicit null. Object fields are selected source-field projections, not opaque approval flags. field_states records absent/null/empty/placeholder as applicable; source evidence retains originals.
Polymorphic owner_table/owner_id and comparison-group members must resolve to emitted table IDs; validate explicitly in addition to listed foreign keys.

assertions.kind is composition, presence, label_statement or clinical. All source-backed assertions have nonempty evidence_ids. clinical only for imported NatMed claims; original_fields preserves complete selected source attributes and source_review independently.

Composition original_fields preserves amount, operator, unit, explicit basis, parent role and qualifiers; clinical original_fields preserves ingredient/population/indication/ratings/dose/interaction/source context. Unknown fields remain unknown.

Mapping relation uses mapping_relation enum; review_state uses identity_review enum. Pilot emits only candidate_unspecified with unreviewed/needs_review; curated recommendations are separate review evidence, never approvals.
Mapping target_snapshot_id must belong to target_record_id; clinical subject_snapshot_id must match the source monograph version; servings/occurrences must resolve within correct label snapshot.

A usable reference key without captured target has null target record/snapshot FKs; target_availability=not_collected. Missing identifiers use not_assessable. Resolved reference requires captured, compatible target; content may remain incomplete.
A snapshot can represent a collection/lookup response with a collector/run-scoped source record, explicitly typed collection_response rather than a domain entity.
MeSH object-only target URI is a reference, not an invented source record. Typed RDF objects preserve URI/literal, datatype and language.
Semantic equivalence does not follow from normalized values. transformations holds proposed derived values separately; original assertions are not overwritten.

Empty/deferred tables are listed as such in manifest with explicit reason; absent file is never silently interpreted as zero rows. No canonical product/ingredient or approval rows are emitted by pilot.
Topic keys refer to a fixed project topic registry recorded in configuration; they are not ingredient canonical IDs.
output_manifest_fields: unresolved counts by stage and unit
execution provenance stored separately from deterministic payloads
